adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the fallback logic in `deleteEvent` (and similarly in `updateEvent`) was changed from using the destination calendar’s `externalId` to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy/undefined (the exact case described), the `find` compares against `undefined` and will almost always return no match, yielding `undefined` instead of the destination calendar’s externalId. This is a real behavior regression compared to the old code’s fallback and can result in an undefined/incorrect calendarId being used for the delete request (or falling back to `primary` elsewhere, deleting from the wrong calendar).
